findings.suggested_fix: Keep the empty-field evaluation guard and export blocking, but render a distinct zero-destination message before the dirty/busy preview branch, such as 'Add an output column or import a template to start the preview.' Cover first upload and removal of the last output in a browser regression.
findings.title: Empty destinations leave preview permanently updating
findings.why_it_matters: After uploading a first source, or removing the final destination row, users see 'Updating preview automatically' indefinitely although no preview run is scheduled. The empty-field guard skips evaluation while dirty remains true, so the preview area never reaches a truthful idle or incomplete state. Render an explicit add-output-columns state for zero destinations while continuing to block download; this avoids inviting users to wait for processing that cannot finish.
